_comment: AI drivers (card 05). cornerMargin = fraction of the computed safe corner speed it uses; brakeMargin = fraction of its estimated max braking it plans with (lower = brakes earlier); lookahead = baseM + perMps x speed; steerKp = gain on the pure-pursuit wheel angle (1 = geometric), steerKd = damping on heading-error change; noise = random steer jitter; mistakesPerMin = chance of a late brake or a wide line; traffic = forward cone and overtaking offset. pits: stop when fuel < fuelLaps laps (race length matched: fuelLaps / the multiplier, but never under reachLaps real laps: enough to get round to the pit entry) or any tyre < minWear; drive the pit lane pitSpeedMarginKph under the limit; with Realistic damage, pit for repair once any zone is past repairDamage. recovery.resetAfterSec: still crawling or stuck this long (reverse-outs not getting it going) -> reset to track like a player, same penalty. start: reaction to lights out, random in min..max per driver. aids: traction control on the rears' slip, as a fraction of peak (03b); trail*: steering more than trailSteer and over its target speed, the AI brakes in proportion to the overspeed (full trailMaxPedal at trailOverspeedMps) instead of a firm 30%+, so the unloaded inside front doesn't lock. traffic.sideGapM: lateral gap kept to a car alongside beyond the cars' width (3-wide is fine if it fits); giving way to a car that has itself (nearly) stopped, it crawls on at crawlMps rather than wait for good. pitLane: through the lane it keeps fastLaneM off the pit path away from the boxes (single file, no passing; it follows only a car in its lane, within its width + laneGapM, and ignores cars parked in boxes), moves across into its own box boxApproachM before it at latRateMps, and waits in the box until the lane is clear releaseGapM back; stopped behind a car that's stopped short of the lane (waiting for it in turn) it creeps on at creepMps (contact.json pitLaneGhosting lets pit-lane cars pass through each other). skill.spread: how far a roster driver's PACE stat (config/drivers.json) moves its corner and braking margins (+-spread at pace 0 / 100); the roster's other stats set mistakes, noise, tyre care, aggression and racecraft. racecraft (AI racecraft card): three lines, NEUTRAL (the racing line), EXIT (through a corner before at least exitStraightM of straight, the line re-optimised through it and exitShiftM past it with the exit's curvature weighted exitWeight x the entry's: a later apex) and INSIDE (insideM toward the inside from insideLeadM before a corner to its apex, edgeM from the edge), picked by a mode re-evaluated every evalSec and held at least holdSec: ATTACK (car ahead within attackGapSec and closing, or in its tow: EXIT before a straight, else NEUTRAL: INSIDE proved slower), DEFEND (car behind within defendGapSec closing: NEUTRAL, plus deploy), NURSE (average tyre below nurseWear or damage past nurseDamage), MANAGE (else: NEUTRAL). Lines blend at blendPerM of a full change per metre; during a blend the slower line's speed counts. overtaking (AI overtaking card): attacking, it closes right up out of corners: a car length + 1.5 m + attackHeadwaySec x (1.5 - aggression) s of headway, back to the full 0.35 s from closeUntilBrakeSec before a braking point, and plans its braking at attackFollowBrake x (just following: 0.8 x); pulled out and closing within commitM it commits to the move: keeps that side until past, aborts if the car gets more than commitM away or it isn't alongside (1.5 car lengths) by the corner; in a tow, pull out pullOutSec + aggression x pullOutAggrSec before the braking point; overlap rule: side by side within overlapM lengthwise with a corner coming, the car on the inside has the right of way (else the car ahead does), and the other leaves it room, dropping just under its speed when there's no room for both; a defender with aggression below concedeBelow lifts for a car overlapped on its inside into a braking zone; blue flags: a car blueLaps or more ahead in the race always has the right of way, and once it's pulled out alongside (within blueBehindM behind) on a straight the lapped car holds its line and lifts blueLift. mistakes (Race noise card): kinds (weights) lateBrake (reads the corner lateBrakeAheadM on, braking planned x lateBrakeMul: overshoots, runs wide), wide (wideM to the outside), wheelspin (traction control off and full throttle out of a corner below wheelspinMaxMps), spin (a spinSteer steering flick for spinSec mid-corner), each waiting up to armSec for its moment (a braking zone, a corner, a slow exit) and then lasting up to durationSec; the chance (mistakesPerMin, scaled by CONSISTENCY) is x (1 + pressureMul) with a car within pressureSec behind, x (1 + attackMul) attacking, x (1 + wearMul x tyre used), x (1 + fuelMul x tank fill). fight.pushMargin: attacking or defending, it drives that much closer to the limit (x (1.5 - tyre care)), so fights cost tyres. coast: lift and coast for small speed drops (<= coastMaxDropMps, above coastMinKph, within 1.5 s) instead of braking, and lift liftBeforeBrakeSec before a braking zone. Round 3 (AI overtaking card): racecraft.coverLeadM: the INSIDE line starts that far before a corner (ramping in over insideLeadM) and moves sideways at most insideSlope m per m, rounded by insideSmooth passes of a 5-point average (unlimited, it jumped 2.5 m at apexes and crawled at 6 m/s there); attackStayGapSec (off when absent): stay ATTACKING within it, closing or not. defence: the defender's choice once per braking zone, decideSec before it, against the nearest car within gapSec behind (not on lap one, not with a car alongside on the inside): COVER (the INSIDE line through that corner) with chance logistic(bias + aggrW x (aggression - 0.5) + threatW x (1 + craftW x (racecraft - 0.5)) x (threat - 0.5) - tyreW x tyre used), threat 0..1 from the gap, the closing speed (closingRefMps = all of it) and the attacker's tow or deploy; else HOLD the racing line. An attacker treats a car ahead coverDetectM or more toward the inside as covering: no dive, it stays on its own line (the cutback). predict: following, it never plans to be faster than the car ahead will be gapM (+ a car length) behind it, along that car's own speed profile x margin on the line it's on (INSIDE when covering), looking lookSec ahead; headwaySec (0.35 when absent) is the plain following headway. overtaking.leaveRoom: with a car overlapped on its inside for the coming corner, take a line a car width + sideGapM wide of it; lapOneCloseUntilBrakeSec: closeUntilBrakeSec on lap one; commitLookSec (off when absent): a committed move looks that far ahead for room. wearAxle (round 4): plan corner speeds from the worse axle's tyre wear, not the four-wheel mean (worn rears under fresher fronts spun cars late in a stint). fuelSave (round 5): SAVE stops once the tank holds releaseLaps more than the flag needs in STANDARD (without it, SAVE was sticky for the race: attackers saved for 90% of their catches and finished with 2-4 laps of fuel spare); it comes back on if the tank runs short again. overtaking.deployBrakeSec (off when absent: 3 s, the pull-out window): deploy until that many seconds before a braking point. brain (AI look-ahead brain card): 'rules' = the follow / pass rules above; 'lookahead' = every lookahead.evalSec, a follower with a car within rangeM ahead (laneM across) tries each lane (car widths + 0.3 m) x each following gap (the plain headway, or gapsM bumper to bumper) x normal / full-limit braking, predicts horizonSec ahead in stepSec steps along the line, and picks the most progress minus contact (closing speed x tapCost below hitMps, x heavyCost at or above), minus the same if the car ahead brakes surpriseDecel harder (weighted surpriseWeight x (1.5 - aggression), reacting after reactSec), minus wallCost per m off the road; an offset lane in a corner is slower by sqrt(1 - offPenalty x |offset x curvature|); full-limit braking costs fullBrakeCostM and each tighter gap tightCostM (tyres); still in line behind the car at the end, ground gained inside the safe gap counts closeCredit x; holdBonusM keeps the current choice. Round 6 (each off when absent): behindM = also predict cars this far behind, and every car's sideways drift (fading latDecay per step); a car that is unsettled (slow or pointing off the line) is predicted to pick up speed at hazardAccel x, takes hazardWidthM more room and may brake like a surprise; holdSafeCostM: the current choice keeps holdBonusM only while its own run is predicted clean (safety beats hysteresis); settleSec / settleHeadingRad: after a mistake, spin or recovery the planner waits until the car is pointing along the line and moving for settleSec; craftReact: re-plan interval and surprise reaction x (1.5 - RACECRAFT); attackStayGapSec: stay in ATTACK (margins, deploy) within that gap, closing or not, without starting the close-up. defend (look-behind): into a braking zone with a car within defence.gapSec behind, predict it to the braking point (closing speed x time + brakeGainM; overlapped = centres within overlapM, a logistic over softM) and COVER only if holding would lose the place (loseCostM x (0.5 + aggression)) for more than covering costs (the INSIDE line's time through the corner + coverCostM); one decision per zone, braking untouched. start (lap one): a seeded launch per driver, bad with chance badChance x (1.5 - consistency) x 2 (half wheelspin for spinSec, half bogging at bogThrottle for bogSec); from lights out the planner tries lanes across the whole road every laneStepM (moveCostM per metre moved) and holds its lane when there is nothing to plan around (no dive to the line), until the first braking zone is within untilBrakeSec, nobody is within spreadM, or lap one ends; lap one's braking x (1 + aggrBrake x (aggression - 0.5)). cutback (crossovers, off: absent; e.g. { "gainSec": 1.5, "minStraightM": 100 }): behind a car covering the inside of a corner before a straight of minStraightM, an outside entry is credited the exit speed the EXIT line buys over the INSIDE line x gainSec. follow (round 7, scale; off when absent or enabled false; both brains): following gap bumper to bumper = gapLengths car lengths + headwaySec x speed, and brakeGapM within brakeZoneSec of a braking point (on the gearbox), each x (1 + aggrScale x (0.5 - aggression)); behind a car it brakes at followBrake x its own planned braking (the rules: 0.8) and never later than the car ahead allows: that car predicted along this car's profile x the ratio it runs at where it is at its limit (else predictMargin), with a reaction of reactSec x (1.5 - racecraft) at the closing speed; alongside it keeps sideGapM clearance (instead of traffic.sideGapM) and passes passOffsetM across (at most the preset's overtakeOffsetM). scale.oxford (round 8, Scale audit card; off when absent or enabled false; both brains): every TRACK value sized for Oxford under one switch, CAR values never. windows: each "section.key": [car lengths, seconds] turns a window in seconds into lengths x car length / speed + seconds, i.e. lengths car lengths + seconds x speed of distance. followCars / followSec: 'following' (brakes earlier) within that many car lengths + seconds x speed, centres (was 8 m + 1.5 s); brakeSoon: a braking zone counts as soon within [lengths, seconds] (was 3 s); deployMinCars: deploy at a car from that many car lengths, centres (was 12 m). follow: the following gaps inside the switch (as round 7's follow block): a train keeps gapLengths car lengths + headwaySec x speed; attackOnly: only a car in ATTACK with a pace advantage of paceAdvMin or more (the car ahead's speed over this car's own profile where it is near its limit, smoothed over paceTauSec) closes to brakeGapM within brakeZoneSec of a braking point and brakes at its own point (followBrake). Tune by racing them (panel: T).
